data.one_liner: A widget that uses a Linear Progress Indicator as a countdown or forward timer.
data.what_it_does: Provides a LinearTimer widget that acts as a visual progress indicator for timers. Supports both forward and countdown modes, callbacks for timer completion, and external control using a LinearTimerController.
use_when: You need a visual linear progress bar that functions as a countdown or forward timer
You require start, stop, and restart controls managed from a parent widget
avoid_when: You need a circular timer or countdown visualization
You require complex time scheduling or background time tracking
strengths: Simple and lightweight widget for visual timers
Allows callbacks when the timer ends
weaknesses: Controller requires manual disposal and a TickerProvider
Limited to linear progress indicator styles
